name: The Tie of Dark and Chaos Magic
effect:
While you control “Dark Magician”, this card is unaffected by your opponent’s card effects.
Monsters named “Magician of Black Chaos” are unaffected by your opponent’s activated card effects and cannot be destroyed by battle.
You can only use each of the following effects of “The Tie of Dark and Chaos Magic” once per turn:
● When this card is activated: You can add 1 card from your Deck or GY that mentions “Ritual of Light and Darkness” to your hand.
● At the start of the Damage Step, if a “Chaos” Ritual Monster you control battles an opponent’s monster: You can banish that opponent’s monster.
● When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, while you control “Dark Magician”: You can negate the activation, and if you do, send that card to the GY.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect, while you control “Dark Magician Girl”: You can negate the activation, and if you do, send that card to the GY.
